resources.string: Unofficial app. Not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Up or Bendigo and Adelaide Bank. Your Personal Access Token is stored encrypted on this phone and only ever sent to Up\'s API (api.up.com.au). Nothing is sent anywhere else.

To update your widgets the moment you pay, Widgets for Up needs notification access.

Android shows this as access to all notifications, but the app only checks which app posted each one. When it's from the Up app, it refreshes your balances from Up's API.

It never reads, stores or sends notification content. You can turn this off at any time in Settings.
